package.name: object_fusion
package.description:
Track-level multi-sensor object fusion. Maintains persistent 3D tracks with an EKF in a vehicle-aligned frame, fusing camera+LiDAR objects, Delphi ESR radar and INS ego motion.
Strictly additive: it consumes /fused_bbox, /lidar_2d_projection and the raw radar as published, modifies no existing node, and emits on its own topics behind default-off gates. Removing this package restores the pre-existing stack exactly.
Every module under object_fusion/ except the *_node.py files is free of rclpy, so the offline A/B harness and the unit tests exercise the production rule rather than a copy.
